title: Patchouli essential oil extends the lifespan and healthspan of Caenorhabditis elegans through JNK-1/DAF-16.
authors: Xu, Rui; Li, Ai-Pei; Tan, Xin; Tang, Xue; He, Xiao-Ping; Wang, Li-Xia; Kang, Juan-Juan; Li, Sheng-Hong; Liu, Yan
one_liner_zh: 研究广藿香精油通过JNK-1/DAF-16通路延长线虫寿命，属于衰老生物学与信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: Patchouli essential oil (PEO) is the major active ingredient of a famous medicinal plant Pogostemon cablin (Blanco) Benth. This study aims to investigate the anti-aging activities of PEO and its major component, and elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms. MAIN METHODS: The anti-aging activities of PEO and its main component patchouli alcohol (PA) were investigated by examining the lifespan, senescence associated indicators as well as stress resistance of Caenorhabditis elegans. RNA-Sequencing was performed to analyze differentially expressed genes and the enrichments of GO and KEGG pathways in nematodes treated with PEO. The potential anti-aging target was predicted using a network pharmacology method and molecular docking. The underlying mechanism of senescence-delaying action was explored using C. elegans mutants and GFP transgenic strains. KEY FINDINGS: PEO modulated lifespan and healthspan extension of worms, ameliorated the senescence characterizations, and increased the survival in stress resistance assays. PEO reduced spawning, lipid accumulation and reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels of nematodes. The levels of anti-oxidative genes and proteins were obviously upregulated after PEO treatment. Moreover, PA was identified to be an ingredient for PEO-mediated nematode longevity. The JNK-1/DAF-16 signaling pathway played a critical role in PEO/PA-mediated longevity. SIGNIFICANCE: The findings revealed that PEO and its major component PA showed significant anti-aging activity through modulating the JNK-1/DAF-16 signaling pathway, which provides a promising strategy to treat aging and age-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 目的：广藿香精油（PEO）是著名药用植物广藿香（Pogostemon cablin (Blanco) Benth.）的主要活性成分。本研究旨在探讨PEO及其主要成分的抗衰老活性，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。主要方法：通过检测秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）的寿命、衰老相关指标及应激抵抗力，研究PEO及其主要成分广藿香醇（patchouli alcohol, PA）的抗衰老活性。采用RNA测序分析PEO处理线虫后的差异表达基因及GO和KEGG通路富集情况。利用网络药理学方法和分子对接预测潜在抗衰老靶点。通过线虫突变体和GFP转基因株系探索延缓衰老作用的潜在机制。主要发现：PEO调节线虫的寿命和健康寿命延长，改善衰老特征，并提高应激抵抗实验中的存活率。PEO减少线虫的产卵量、脂质积累和活性氧（ROS）水平。PEO处理后，抗氧化基因和蛋白水平显著上调。此外，PA被鉴定为PEO介导线虫长寿的成分。JNK-1/DAF-16信号通路在PEO/PA介导的长寿中发挥关键作用。意义：研究结果表明，PEO及其主要成分PA通过调节JNK-1/DAF-16信号通路表现出显著的抗衰老活性，这为治疗衰老及衰老相关疾病提供了一种有前景的策略。
